source.modification_notice: Adapted by SafeConnect: the official tables were extracted into JSON with names, codes, parents and coordinates unchanged; the links between the 2020 and 2023 codes and to the national portal list were derived by tools/build_master_areas.py and are marked as derived. BBS, OCHA and HDX do not endorse SafeConnect or this adaptation.
source.note: Levels 1 to 3 (8 divisions, 64 districts, 507 upazila-level units = 495 upazilas + 12 city corporations) carry the 2023 codes (10 digits for level 3). The point table (union and old upazila / metropolitan thana points) is dated 2020-11-13 and uses the OLD 8-digit level-3 codes. The current HDX dataset (v03) has polygons for levels 1 to 3 only: unions are points. A 2020 BBS / OCHA ROAP union polygon set (5,160 units) exists only as a third-party copy (geoBoundaries) and is NOT used here.
